*Niyyānikaduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.67) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna, the final book of the Pali Tipiṭaka. Methodologically, the work analyzes conditional relations through the intersection of the *niyyānika-duka* (the dyad of states leading out to liberation and those not leading out) and the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states).
